findings.summary: _roadmap_scoped's docstring still says the registered MCP wrapper 'defaults single-project clients to the compact summary', which is exactly the behaviour this change replaces; a reader of the function's contract is pointed at the old default.

This file is outside the node's declared write paths; the rename and the explicit view="summary" call are required by the section's own done-when, and the worker disclosed the edit under outside_scope, so the coordinator must add the path to the node's grants at promotion or revert it.

DEFAULT_VIEWS still maps roadmap to summary and VIEW_BUDGETS has no ("roadmap", "brief") row, so the new default answer is held to the 20,000-character summary row; the brief serialised to 17,772 on reckon, and a project only ~13% larger would have its default read refused by a budget sized for the payload it replaced.
